title: Security Intake Signal Factory & Prioritization Canvas
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary: Build a unified 'Signal Factory' and Prioritization Canvas for incoming enterprise security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, DPA, vendor questionnaire requests, and bespoke contractual clauses). The deliverable is a repeatable intake playbook, an automated scoring engine prototype, and a set of template responses and evidence bundles for high-frequency asks.

Problem: Currently requests arrive through multiple channels (sales, support, solutions, legal) with inconsistent context, manual re-triage, long SLAs, and repeated one-off work across teams. This causes slow time-to-commit, uneven SLAs for customers, and duplicated effort across PM, Legal, Security, and Engineering.

Goals:
- Reduce median time-to-first-response for enterprise security asks from current ~7 business days to <=48 hours for express lane and <=5 business days for standard lane.
- Automate initial prioritization so 60% of incoming questionnaires are assigned a priority lane automatically with pre-populated evidence suggestions.
- Provide clear escalations for high-risk asks that require engineering changes or product gating.
- Produce an evidence-bundling template and DPA diffing checklist to accelerate negotiations.

Scope (in-scope):
- Intake forms, email routing, and a lightweight webhook from CRM to create structured signal.
- A scoring rubric (Signal Factory) based on impact/risk/value to assign lanes: Express / Standard / Legal-Review / Engineering-Dependency.
- Evidence bundler (packaging SOC2/ISO docs, encryption/KMS statements, data flow diagrams, data residency notes) and template responses for common questionnaire items.
- Dashboard for queue visibility (per-customer SLA, lane distribution, TTFR, backlog by team).

Out-of-scope (initial):
- Full automation of all questionnaire answers (longer-term).
- Changes to contract language or legal final approvals (Legal remains gatekeeper).

Proposed Prioritization Canvas (Signal factors and weights):
- Regulated Data (HIPAA/PHI): +30
- Data Residency or Transfer restrictions (GDPR/DPA region constraints): +20
- Contract Value / ARR (>$250k): +15
- Product Impact (requires runtime or policy changes): +25
- SLA / Uptime requirement changes: +10
- Customer Tier (Strategic / Named): +10
- Time sensitivity (deal accelerators, RFP deadlines <14 days): +20
- Re-run / Repeat Ask (we already have evidence): -10
Score interpretation: >=50 => Express lane (48h TTFR); 30-49 => Standard lane (5bd); 15-29 => Legal-Review queue; <15 => Low priority / self-serve.

Automation and tooling approach:
- Build a lightweight webhook that normalizes CRM/Support/Email inputs into a JSON signal, backed by a small rules engine to compute score.
- Use vectorized fingerprinting of long questionnaires to detect repeats and suggest cached answers/evidence.
- Evidence bundler: single-click package generation (PDF + access links) with audit-stamped artifacts.
- Integrations: Slack notifications to triage channel; Redwood Console lane dashboard; Confluence/Drive template references.

Acceptance criteria:
- PoC scoring engine accepts 3 representative incoming signals and assigns the correct lane per rubric with >=80% agreement to SME review.
- Express lane SLA set and communicated; run pilot with 3 named accounts and meet TTFR <=48h for at least 8/10 requests in pilot.
- Evidence bundler can assemble SOC2 artefacts + dataflow diagram for 2 sample customers and produce audit-ready package.
- Dashboards display lane counts, median TTFR, backlog age, and owner.

Risks & Mitigations: 
- Risk: Over-automation could misclassify subtle legal asks.
  Mitigation: Keep Legal as final reviewer for 'Legal-Review' and add manual override path.
- Risk: Evidence is stale or incomplete.
  Mitigation: Versioned artifacts with TTL and periodic re-certification reminders.
- Risk: Sales or CSM bypassing intake and escalating ad-hoc.
  Mitigation: Sales enablement materials + SLAs tied to prioritization; require intake record for tracking.

Rollout plan:
1) Week 0-2: Alignment and sample set collection (collect 100 representative requests).
2) Week 3-5: Build scoring rules engine and evidence bundler PoC.
3) Week 6: Pilot with 3 strategic customers and internal Sales/CSM usage.
4) Week 7-8: Iterate on rubric, expand to 10 customers, ship Console dashboard beta.
5) Week 9-12: Full rollout to enterprise intake and handoff to Operations for runbook.

Metrics to track: median TTFR, % auto-classified, mean time-to-resolution, number of escalations to Eng/Legal, customer satisfaction NPS for enterprise onboarding.

Stakeholders: Product (PM), Security & Compliance, Legal, Solutions Engineering, Sales/CSM, Engineering (infra/runtime), DevRel (templates).

Deliverables: Prioritization Canvas doc, scoring engine PoC, evidence bundler MVP, Console dashboard beta, playbook + runbook + training slides.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Kickoff: Collected 40 sample requests from Sales and Support. Initial patterns: ~30% are DPA/dataroom asks, 20% are SOC2/ISO evidence bundles, 15% are GDPR data flow questions, remainder were bespoke clauses.

2026-03-04 - Decision: Use a hybrid rules + ML fingerprint approach. Rules for clear signals (HIPAA/GDPR markers, deal value) and fingerprinting for repeat questionnaires. Action: ENG-2418 to prototype fingerprint service.

2026-03-06 - Legal sync: Legal prefers 'Legal-Review' lane for any clause changes. Agreed to surfaced summary and suggested template language but final sign-off remains with Legal. Added 'legal_escalation_hint' to outputs.
2026-03-08 - UX mockups: Confluence link to Canvas and Console views: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENT/Security+Signal+Factory (mockups attached). Requesting design review from DES-1124.

2026-03-09 - Pilot plan approved: Marcus to run pilot with 3 named accounts (Acme, NovaHealth, Tradewind). Goal: Validate TTFR and evidence bundler output. PRD link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1-SecuritySignalFactory-PRD
2026-03-10 - Next: ENG to deliver PoC scoring API end of week; PM to finalize acceptance checklist and pilot kickoff materials.
